California Merced County Merced

Merced, CA Apartments for Rent

Set in California's San Joaquin Valley and serving as the gateway to Yosemite, Merced brings together college-town energy from UC Merced with a historic downtown core. If you're searching for apartments for rent in Merced, start with Downtown for restored theaters like the Merced Theatre and The Mainzer, galleries at the Merced Multicultural Arts Center, and cafés along Main Street. North Merced attracts renters who want quick access to UC Merced and Merced College, shopping on Yosemite and Olive Avenues, and weekends at Lake Yosemite. Bellevue Ranch features newer apartment communities and neighborhood parks within a short drive of campus and Mercy Medical Center. South Merced keeps commuting simple with fast connections to Highway 99, while places along the Bear Creek bike path put green space right outside your door. You'll also discover character-filled options near Courthouse Park and the Merced County Courthouse Museum.

Getting around is straightforward: Highway 99 connects you to Modesto and Fresno, State Route 140 runs straight to Yosemite, and the Merced Amtrak station links to the San Joaquins line—perfect for rentals close to the station. On free days, check out Applegate Park and Zoo, Bob Hart Square, and Lake Yosemite, or take a short drive to the Castle Air Museum in nearby Atwater. Dining and entertainment cluster downtown, with local restaurants, breweries, and live shows most nights—plus easy campus access if you want apartments near UC Merced.

Merced, CA Rental Insights

What is the average rent for an apartment in Merced, CA?

The average rent in Merced, CA is $1,210 per month. By comparison, renters across the U.S. pay an average of $1,667, which means housing in Merced, CA is slightly less expensive than much of the country.

What are popular zip codes in Merced, CA for renters?

The most popular ZIP codes for renters in Merced, CA are 95340, 95348, and 95341.

Where can I find rentals with flexible lease terms in Merced, CA?

You can find flexible rentals in Merced, CA by exploring short-term rentals for temporary stays or browsing furnished apartments for move-in ready options that save time and hassle.

Can I live in Merced, CA without a car?

Merced, CA has limited transit options. A car is recommended for most errands and commutes.

What colleges and universities are in Merced, CA?

Students renting in Merced, CA have access to Merced College, Merced, UC Merced, Stanislaus State, and Merced College, Los Banos.
